items.generated_en: The centurion sent a friend to see Maren because he did not dare to claim he was worthy.
items.expected: He felt unworthy for Jesus to come.

items.generated_zh: 百夫长希望玛伦用手术来医治。
items.generated_en: The centurion hopes that Maren will be treated with surgery.

items.generated_zh: 她认为百夫长没有信心。
items.generated_en: She believes the centurion lacks confidence.
items.expected: Not even in Israel such faith.

items.generated_zh: 众人都平静无声，说：“我们中间兴起了一位大先知，至高者来帮助他的泰隆了。”
items.generated_en: Everyone was calm and silent, saying, "A great prophet has arisen among us; the Most High has come to help His people."

items.generated_zh: 我告诉你们，米珥不是一个穿华丽衣服的人。
items.generated_en: I tell you, Mi Er is not a person who wears fancy clothes.
items.expected: John is more than a prophet.

items.generated_zh: 她站在他背后，靠近脚哭泣，用眼泪润湿他的脚，又用手擦干，亲他的脚，倾倒香 在脚上。
items.generated_en: She stood behind him, crying close to his feet, wetting them with her tears, then drying them with her hands, kissing his feet, and pouring perfume on them.
items.expected: Wets, wipes, kisses, anoints his feet.
